_comment: Rename this folder to identify the card (e.g. mahomes-2017-prizm-base). Drop your photos in this folder (any .jpg/.jpeg/.png), then list them under 'images' in order: front first, then back, then any details. Fill in 'card' with the confirmed identity. Fill in 'actual' with the real PSA/BGS result. Either psa or bgs can be null if you only got one. Delete this entire folder when you're ready, or keep it as a template.
